```{r}
# Variables
CMBnr <- "CMB-2219_1_20"
cells <- "HepG2"
output_folder <- paste0("Datasets/results/",CMBnr)
if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder)
}
passage_baseline  <- "P0"   # Reference passage
passage_of_interest <- "P19"  # Passage to compare against baseline
tag <- paste0(passage_of_interest, "_vs_", passage_baseline, "_", CMBnr)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

# 1. LOAD EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN & STATS FILE

# =============================================================================

exp_design <- read.csv(paste0("Datasets/",CMBnr,"/Experimental_design_", CMBnr,".csv"), sep = ";") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Group, Replicate, Injection_Order, Run) %>%
  
  mutate(
    passage_nr = as.integer(str_extract(Group, "[0-9]+$"))-1, #-1 as passage mistakenly starts at 1 in experimental design file
    passage    = paste0("P", passage_nr)
  )

cat("Experimental Design (lookup-tabel):\n")
statsfile <- read_tsv(paste0("Datasets/",CMBnr,"/report.stats.tsv"))
print(exp_design)

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

# 2. READ PARQUET 

# =============================================================================
 
# READ PARQUET

raw <- read_parquet(paste0("Datasets/",CMBnr,"/report.parquet"))
 
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

# 3. SAMPLE QC (PEPTIDE LENGTH DISTRIBUTION, TRYPTIC EFFICIENCY, CHARGE STATE, PRECURSOR IDENTIFICATION)

# =============================================================================

data_qc <- raw %>%
  inner_join(exp_design, by = "Run") %>%
  mutate(
    passage = paste0(passage, "_", Replicate),
    
    # Peptide Length Calculation
    Peptide_Length = nchar(Stripped.Sequence),
    
    # Missed Cleavages (Trypsin)
    Internal_Seq = stringr::str_sub(Stripped.Sequence, start = 1, end = -2),
    Missed_Cleavages = stringr::str_count(Internal_Seq, "[KR](?!P)"),
    Missed_Cleavages = ifelse(Missed_Cleavages >= 2, "2", as.character(Missed_Cleavages)),
    Missed_Cleavages = factor(Missed_Cleavages, levels = c("2", "1", "0")),
    
    # Precursor Charge State
    Precursor.Charge = as.factor(Precursor.Charge)
  )

unique_passages <- unique(data_qc$passage)
passage_nums <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(unique_passages, "(?<=P)\\d+"))
replicate_nums <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(unique_passages, "\\d+$"))
correct_order <- unique_passages[order(passage_nums, replicate_nums)]

data_qc <- data_qc %>%
  mutate(passage = factor(passage, levels = correct_order)) %>%
  select(passage, Stripped.Sequence, Precursor.Charge, Precursor.Id, Peptide_Length, Missed_Cleavages)
```

```{r}
# Peptide Length Distribution

# Plot overlaid density curves to check for a uniform distribution shape
p_peptidelength <- ggplot(data_qc, aes(x = Peptide_Length, color = passage)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, alpha = 0.1, size = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(5, 35, by = 5), limits = c(5, 35)) +

       subtitle = "Overlaid profiles to check for consistent digestion across runs",
       x = "Peptide Length (Amino Acids)",
       y = "Density",
       color = "Passage") +
  
  # Force a 3-column legend grid
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size = 1.2))) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5), 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),                 
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),                
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),               
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0) 
  )

print(p_peptidelength)
```

```{r}
#Combined Box Plots for Tryptic Efficiency, Charge State, and Number of Precursors Identified

# Outlier Detection Function
find_outliers <- function(x, labels) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  is_out <- x < (q1 - 1.5 * iqr) | x > (q3 + 1.5 * iqr)
  return(ifelse(is_out, as.character(labels), NA))
}

# Tryptic Digestion Efficiency
digestion_index <- data_qc %>%
  mutate(Missed_Numeric = as.numeric(as.character(Missed_Cleavages))) %>%
  group_by(passage) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Missed_Cleavages = mean(Missed_Numeric, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(outlier_label = find_outliers(Avg_Missed_Cleavages, passage))

p1 <- ggplot(digestion_index, aes(x = "", y = Avg_Missed_Cleavages)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#2a9d8f", alpha = 0.4, width = 0.4) +
  geom_point(color = "#264653", alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = outlier_label), na.rm = TRUE, min_segment_length = 0,
                  box.padding = 0.5, fontface = "bold", color = "firebrick", nudge_x = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Tryptic Digestion Efficiency",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Missed Cleavages per Peptide"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# Precursor Charge State
charge_index <- data_qc %>%
  mutate(Charge_Numeric = as.numeric(as.character(Precursor.Charge))) %>%
  group_by(passage) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Charge = mean(Charge_Numeric, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(outlier_label = find_outliers(Avg_Charge, passage))

p2 <- ggplot(charge_index, aes(x = "", y = Avg_Charge)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#e76f51", alpha = 0.4, width = 0.4) +
  geom_point(color = "#264653", alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = outlier_label), na.rm = TRUE, min_segment_length = 0,
                  box.padding = 0.5, fontface = "bold", color = "firebrick", nudge_x = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Precursor Charge State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Charge State per Precursor"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# Number of Precursor IDs 
precursor_data <- exp_design %>%
  left_join(
    statsfile %>% 
      mutate(
        Clean_Run_Name = sub("\\.raw$", "", basename(File.Name))
      ) %>% 
      select(Clean_Run_Name, Precursors.Identified),
    by = c("Run" = "Clean_Run_Name")) %>%
  mutate(passage = paste0(passage, "_", Replicate),
         outlier_label = find_outliers(Precursors.Identified, passage)
         )

p3 <- ggplot(precursor_data, aes(x = "", y = Precursors.Identified)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#e76f51", alpha = 0.4, width = 0.4) +
  geom_point(color = "#264653", alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = outlier_label), na.rm = TRUE, min_segment_length = 0,
                  box.padding = 0.5, fontface = "bold", color = "firebrick", nudge_x = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Precursor Identification",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Identified Precursors"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# Box Plot Combination
p_combined_qc_dashboard <- p1 | p2 | p3

p_combined_qc_dashboard <- p_combined_qc_dashboard + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Outlier Detection in Quality Control Boxplots of Cell Line HepG2",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic")
    )
  )

print(p_combined_qc_dashboard)
```

```{r}
#Missingness Calculation
# 1. Determine the total "Universe" of unique precursors (Sequence)
total_global_precursors <- raw %>%
  distinct(Precursor.Id) %>%
  nrow()

# 2. Pipeline to calculate missingness percentage per sample
sample_missingness <- data_qc %>%
  # Isolate unique precursors identified within each individual sample
  distinct(passage, Precursor.Id) %>%
  
  # Group by your ordered passage factor
  group_by(passage) %>%
  
  # Count present features and calculate what percentage of the global universe is missing
  summarise(
    precursors_present = n(),
    missing = total_global_precursors - precursors_present,
    missingness_percentage = (missing / total_global_precursors) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Inspect your per-sample quality metrics
print(sample_missingness)

# 3. Summary statistics across all samples (mean, SD, range)
sample_missingness_summary <- sample_missingness %>%
  summarise(
    mean_missingness   = mean(missingness_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_missingness      = sd(missingness_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_missingness      = min(missingness_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_missingness      = max(missingness_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_missingness    = max_missingness - min_missingness
  )

print(sample_missingness_summary)

# 4. Outlier detection (IQR method, consistent with your combined QC dashboard)
find_outliers <- function(x, labels) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  is_out <- x < (q1 - 1.5 * iqr) | x > (q3 + 1.5 * iqr)
  return(ifelse(is_out, as.character(labels), NA))
}

sample_missingness <- sample_missingness %>%
  mutate(outlier_label = find_outliers(missingness_percentage, passage))

# Print flagged outliers only
sample_missingness %>%
  filter(!is.na(outlier_label)) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# Scatter plot to identify a possible trend in precursor identification
# Sort the data by injection order
scatter_data <- precursor_data %>%
  arrange(Injection_Order)

# Compute the Linear Model
drift_model <- lm(Precursors.Identified ~ Injection_Order, data = scatter_data)
r_squared   <- summary(drift_model)$r.squared
r2_string   <- paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3))

# Scatter plot
p_driftscatter <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = Injection_Order, y = Precursors.Identified)) +
  # Linear trend line with a 95% confidence interval ribbon
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "#2a9d8f", fill = "#2a9d8f", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_point(color = "#264653", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  theme_minimal() +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scatter_data$Injection_Order,
    labels = paste0("#", scatter_data$Injection_Order, " (", scatter_data$passage, ")")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Mass Spectrometer Signal Drift Analysis",
    subtitle = paste0("Identification stability across acquisition timeline\n(", r2_string, ")"),
    x = "Injection Sequence (Technical Passage)",
    y = "Identified Precursor Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", color = "gray25", margin = margin(b = 22)),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_driftscatter)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

# 4. PREPROCESSING & PROTEIN AGGREGATION

# =============================================================================

# Outlier Removal 

remove_outliers <- TRUE         # set FALSE if you want with outliers
outlier_passages <- c("P14")    # Add more passages if needed, see QC

if (remove_outliers) {

  # Find all Run IDs belonging to the outlier passage(s)
  outlier_runs <- exp_design %>%
    dplyr::filter(passage %in% outlier_passages) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Run)

  # Remove these runs from the experimental design
  exp_design <- exp_design %>%
    dplyr::filter(!Run %in% outlier_runs)

} else {
  outlier_runs <- character(0)
}

# Filtering

raw_filtered <- raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !Run %in% outlier_runs,     # Remove all outlier runs !! BEFORE filtering
    Q.Value    <= 0.01,
    PG.Q.Value <= 0.01,
    !grepl("cRAP", Protein.Group),
    !grepl("cRAP", Protein.Ids)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Protein.Group = sub(";.*", "", Protein.Group),
    Protein.Ids   = sub(";.*", "", Protein.Ids)
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "\nRows after outlier, FDR and cRAP filtering: %d (van %d)\n",
  nrow(raw_filtered), nrow(raw)
))
```

```{r}
# Join the data
raw_filtered_annotated <- raw_filtered %>%
  inner_join(exp_design, by = "Run")

# Define factor levels
sample_levels <- mixedsort(unique(raw_filtered_annotated$Sample))

# apply the factor
raw_filtered_annotated$Sample <- factor(raw_filtered_annotated$Sample, 
                                        levels = sample_levels)

# Reshape the data
raw_wide <- raw_filtered_annotated %>%
  select(Precursor.Id, Protein.Ids, Sample, Genes, Precursor.Quantity) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample, 
    values_from = Precursor.Quantity
  ) %>%
  select(Precursor.Id, Protein.Ids, Genes, all_of(as.character(sample_levels)))

# Identify which columns in diann_wide are the sample intensities
intensity_cols <- exp_design$Sample

# Create the object
pe <- readQFeatures(
  raw_wide, 
  ecol = intensity_cols, 
  name = "precursor_raw", 
  fnames = "Precursor.Id"
  
)

```

```{r}
# filtering NA treshold 70%
rowData(pe[["precursor_raw"]])$nValid <- rowSums(!is.na(assay(pe[["precursor_raw"]])))
threshold <- ncol(assay(pe[["precursor_raw"]])) * 0.7

n_samples <- ncol(pe[["precursor_raw"]])
pct_valid <- (rowSums(!is.na(assay(pe[["precursor_raw"]]))) / n_samples) * 100

# Set breaks to n_samples + 1 so each bin corresponds to exactly 1 sample count
hist(pct_valid, 
     breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = n_samples + 1), 
     col = "steelblue", 
     main = "Sample Completeness per Precursor",
     xlab = "Percentage of Samples Containing Precursor (%)", 
     ylab = "Frequency (Number of Precursors)",
     xlim = c(0, 100),
     xaxt = "n"
)

# Custom 10% step axis and 70% cutoff line
axis(1, at = seq(0, 100, by = 10))
abline(v = 70, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Apply filter
pe <- filterFeatures(pe, ~ nValid >= threshold)
cat("Precursors after 70% completeness filter:", nrow(pe[["precursor_raw"]]), "\n")

# Log transform (base 2)
pe <- logTransform(pe, i = "precursor_raw", name = "precursor_log")

# Normalize (median centering)
pe <- normalize(pe, i = "precursor_log", name = "precursor_norm", method = "center.median")

# Aggregate precursors to protein level
pe <- aggregateFeatures(
  pe, 
  i = "precursor_norm", 
  fcol = "Protein.Ids", 
  name = "protein",
  fun = MsCoreUtils::robustSummary
)

# Identify the number of proteins in the aggregated assay
num_proteins <- nrow(pe[["protein"]])

cat("Number of unique proteins after aggregation:", num_proteins, "\n")
```

```{R}
# =============================================================================

# 5. PCA PLOTS

# =============================================================================

# Perform QRILC imputation on the "protein" assay
pe <- impute(pe, i = "protein", method = "QRILC", name = "protein_qrilc")

# Extract the complete matrix for PCA
mat_pca_imp <- assay(pe, "protein_qrilc")

 
# PCA

pca     <- prcomp(t(mat_pca_imp), scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

pct_var <- round(summary(pca)$importance[2, ] * 100, 1)
 
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%

  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%

  left_join(dplyr::select(exp_design, Sample, passage, Replicate),

            by = "Sample")
 
# color palette

nrofpassages <- max(exp_design$passage_nr, na.rm = TRUE)
pal_passages <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()((nrofpassages+2)), paste0("P", 0:(nrofpassages+1)))

#labeling 

passage_levels <- paste0("P", 0:(nrofpassages+1))

pca_df$passage <- factor(pca_df$passage, levels = passage_levels)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# =============================================================================

# 8. DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS

# =============================================================================

# --- TREND ANALYSIS BRANCH ---
pe_trend <- pe

# Determine the second-to-last passage dynamically
all_passages <- sort(unique(colData(pe_trend)$passage_nr))
max_passage  <- max(all_passages)
second_to_last <- all_passages[length(all_passages) - 1]

# Subset 'pe_trend' to keep only passage 1 up to the second-to-last passage
keep_samples <- colData(pe_trend)$passage_nr >= 1 & 
  colData(pe_trend)$passage_nr <= second_to_last

pe_trend <- pe_trend[, keep_samples, ]

# Fit the model and perform hypothesis testing on the subsetted data
pe_trend <- msqrob(pe_trend, i = "protein", formula = ~passage_nr, overwrite = TRUE)

L_trend <- makeContrast("passage_nr = 0", 
                        parameterNames = colnames(model.matrix(~passage_nr, colData(pe_trend))))

pe_trend <- hypothesisTest(pe_trend, i = "protein", contrast = L_trend)

# --- PAIRWISE ANALYSIS BRANCH ---
pe_pair <- pe
pe_pair <- msqrob(pe_pair, i = "protein", formula = ~passage, overwrite = TRUE)

contrast_name <- paste0("passage", passage_of_interest)
contrast_str  <- paste0(contrast_name, " = 0")

L_pair <- makeContrast(contrast_str,
                       parameterNames = colnames(model.matrix(~passage, colData(pe_pair))))
pe_pair <- hypothesisTest(pe_pair, i = "protein", contrast = L_pair)

```

```{r}
# Extract Trend (Slope across all passages)
res_trend <- rowData(pe_trend[["protein"]])$passage_nr %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Protein.Ids") %>%
  left_join(gene_lookup, by = "Protein.Ids") %>%
  mutate(Genes = ifelse(is.na(Genes) | Genes == "", Protein.Ids, Genes))

# --- HEATMAP --- 

# 1. Filter for ALL differentially expressed proteins (adjPval < 0.05)
sig_trend_data <- res_trend %>%
  filter(adjPval < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(adjPval)

sig_trend_ids <- sig_trend_data$Protein.Ids

# 2. Extract and format matrix
heatmap_data <- assay(pe_trend[["protein"]])[sig_trend_ids, ]

# Order columns by passage number so the trend displays chronologically
col_order <- order(colData(pe_trend)$passage_nr)
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[, col_order]

# Format column names
colnames(heatmap_data) <- paste0("P", colData(pe_trend)$passage_nr[col_order],
                                 "_",
                                 sub(".*_", "", rownames(colData(pe_trend))[col_order]))

# 3. Z-score scale across rows (proteins)
heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))

# 4. Generate High-Density Heatmap
# Cut the proteins into 4 main trend clusters to give the dendrogram meaning
p_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_scaled,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cutree_rows = 2,             # Splits dendrogram into 3 logical expression clusters
  treeheight_row = 30,         # Shrinks dendrogram width so it doesn't overpower the plot
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  border_color = NA,
  color = viridis(100),
  main = "Longitudinal Trend Differentially Expressed Proteins of Cell Line HepG2",
  angle_col = 90,              # Rotates x-axis labels to 90 degrees for better readability
  use_raster = TRUE,           # Removes white line rendering artifacts
  legend_breaks = c(-4, -2, 0, 2),
  legend_labels = c("-4", "-2", "0", "2 (Z-score)") # Explicitly labels the scale
)

print(p_heatmap)
```

```{r}
# Trend and pairwise DEA results

df_trend <- res_trend %>%
  select(Gene = Genes, logFC_trend = logFC, pval_trend = adjPval) %>%
  mutate(Gene = trimws(as.character(Gene)))

df_pair <- res_pair %>%
  select(Gene = Genes, logFC_pair = logFC, pval_pair = adjPval) %>%
  mutate(Gene = trimws(as.character(Gene)))

# --- CLASSIFY & FILTER EACH ANALYSIS SEPARATELY ---

# --- Trend analysis ---
trend_table <- df_trend %>%
  mutate(
    sig_trend = pval_trend < 0.05,
    Status = case_when(
      pval_trend < 0.05 & logFC_trend > 0 ~ "Trend Up",
      pval_trend < 0.05 & logFC_trend < 0 ~ "Trend Down",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(sig_trend) %>%
  select(Gene, logFC_trend, pval_trend, Status)

# --- Pairwise analysis ---
pair_table <- df_pair %>%
  mutate(
    sig_pair = pval_pair < 0.05 & abs(logFC_pair) > fc_cutoff,
    Status = case_when(
      pval_pair < 0.05 & logFC_pair >  fc_cutoff ~ "Upregulated",
      pval_pair < 0.05 & logFC_pair < -fc_cutoff ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(sig_pair) %>%
  select(Gene, logFC_pair, pval_pair, Status)

# --- UNIQUE SIGNIFICANT PROTEIN LISTS (PER ANALYSIS) ---
trend_sig_proteins <- trend_table %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
pair_sig_proteins  <- pair_table  %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()

# Background set for STRING enrichment analysis 
background_list <- rownames(pe_pair[["protein"]])
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

# 10. EXTRA ANALYSES

# =============================================================================
# ============================================================
# KRT CONTAMINATION / TECHNICAL EFFECT CHECK
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define keratin proteins of interest
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_lookup <- tribble(
  ~Protein.Ids, ~Gene,
  "O95678",     "KRT6A",
  "P08779",     "KRT16",
  "Q04695",     "KRT17",
  "P13647",     "KRT5",
  "P02533",     "KRT14",
  "P02538",     "KRT8",
  "P05787",     "KRT8"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract KRT abundance from the protein assay
# ------------------------------------------------------------

prot_mat <- assay(pe_pair[["protein"]])

krt_data <- prot_mat[
  rownames(prot_mat) %in% krt_lookup$Protein.Ids,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Protein.Ids") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Protein.Ids,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  left_join(krt_lookup, by = "Protein.Ids")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Add experimental metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------


krt_data <- krt_data %>%
  left_join(
    exp_design %>%
      select(
        Sample,
        passage,
        passage_nr,
        Replicate,
        Injection_Order,
        Run
      ),
    by = "Sample"
  )

# Quick sanity check
print(
  krt_data %>%
    select(
      Protein.Ids,
      Gene,
      Sample,
      passage,
      passage_nr,
      Replicate,
      Injection_Order,
      Abundance
    ) %>%
    head(20)
)

# Check how many observations per KRT
cat("\n--- KRT observations ---\n")
print(table(krt_data$Gene, useNA = "ifany"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot KRT abundance across passage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_krt_passage <- ggplot(
  krt_data,
  aes(
    x = passage_nr,
    y = Abundance
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = factor(Replicate)),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Gene + Protein.Ids,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Keratin abundance across HepG2 passages",
    x = "Passage",
    y = "Protein abundance",
    shape = "Replicate"
  )

print(p_krt_passage)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot KRT abundance versus injection order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_krt_injection <- ggplot(
  krt_data,
  aes(
    x = Injection_Order,
    y = Abundance
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = factor(Replicate)),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Gene + Protein.Ids,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Keratin abundance versus injection order",
    x = "Injection order",
    y = "Protein abundance",
    shape = "Replicate"
  )

print(p_krt_injection)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. P0 versus P19 visualisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_p0_p19 <- krt_data %>%
  filter(passage %in% c("P0", "P19"))

p_krt_p0_p19 <- ggplot(
  krt_p0_p19,
  aes(
    x = passage,
    y = Abundance
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = factor(Replicate)),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Gene + Protein.Ids,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Keratin abundance in P0 versus P19",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein abundance",
    shape = "Replicate"
  )

print(p_krt_p0_p19)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Test association with injection order only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_injection_test <- krt_data %>%
  group_by(Protein.Ids, Gene) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(Abundance)) >= 10) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    fit <- lm(
      Abundance ~ Injection_Order,
      data = .x
    )

    broom::tidy(fit) %>%
      filter(term == "Injection_Order")

  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    adj_p = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  )

cat("\n--- Injection order association ---\n")
print(krt_injection_test)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Test passage and injection order simultaneously
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_models <- krt_data %>%
  group_by(Protein.Ids, Gene) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(Abundance)) >= 10) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    fit <- lm(
      Abundance ~ passage_nr + Injection_Order,
      data = .x
    )

    broom::tidy(fit)

  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    term %in% c("passage_nr", "Injection_Order")
  ) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    adj_p = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n--- Passage + injection order model ---\n")

print(
  krt_models %>%
    select(
      Protein.Ids,
      Gene,
      term,
      estimate,
      std.error,
      statistic,
      p.value,
      adj_p
    ) %>%
    arrange(Gene, Protein.Ids, term)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Calculate an overall keratin score per sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_scaled <- krt_data %>%
  group_by(Protein.Ids) %>%
  mutate(
    KRT_z = as.numeric(scale(Abundance))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

krt_sample_score <- krt_scaled %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    passage,
    passage_nr,
    Replicate,
    Injection_Order
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_KRT_z = mean(KRT_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_KRT = sum(!is.na(KRT_z)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_KRT_z = ifelse(
      is.nan(mean_KRT_z),
      NA,
      mean_KRT_z
    )
  )

p_krt_score <- ggplot(
  krt_sample_score,
  aes(
    x = passage_nr,
    y = mean_KRT_z
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = factor(Replicate)),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Overall keratin signal across passage",
    x = "Passage",
    y = "Mean keratin z-score",
    shape = "Replicate"
  )

print(p_krt_score)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Simple summary table for interpretation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_summary <- krt_data %>%
  group_by(Protein.Ids, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observed = sum(!is.na(Abundance)),
    mean_P0 = mean(
      Abundance[passage == "P0"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_P19 = mean(
      Abundance[passage == "P19"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    difference_P19_P0 = mean_P19 - mean_P0,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- KRT P0-P19 summary ---\n")
print(krt_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Combine model results into an interpretation table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

krt_model_summary <- krt_models %>%
  select(
    Protein.Ids,
    Gene,
    term,
    estimate,
    adj_p
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, adj_p)
  )

cat("\n--- KRT technical-effect summary ---\n")
print(krt_model_summary)

```
